messages:
Ava (SupplyOps): Quick one — vendor scanned two H100 returns as DOA at the EU forwarder. They propose one consolidated RMA to lower per-unit brokerage but need us to confirm declared value and HS code mapping.
Diego (Logistics): Drop AWBs and weights? Consolidation usually saves about €350 but can add a hub dwell of ~20h.
Ava (SupplyOps): AWBs:
MAWB-prop: EU-MAWB-6731
AWB: EU-541-9001 (30kg), EU-541-9002 (29kg)
ETA if merged: 2026-08-12
Marta (Procurement): Vendor suggests declared value €260,000 total and will credit €400 brokerage if paperwork caused reroute. I need invoice scans before accepting any reduced declared value.
Ken (Infra): These were booked for eu-west-1 capacity top-up. Thermal hold ~72h; if hub adds >24h we should preempt by moving a spare from DE pool to the cluster. I'll enable alerting for spare pool <45%.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-4319. Attach photos and proforma.
Diego (Logistics): Forwarder can provide house manifest mapping AWBs->MAWB. Final consolidated brokerage quoted €320. If procurement confirms invoice and declared value, consolidation makes sense.
Marta (Procurement): Uploading invoice scan now and asking vendor to confirm €500 credit instead of €400. Also logging PO amendment PO-6612-AMD1.
Ava (SupplyOps): Decision rule: consolidate if brokerage <= €350, house manifest present, and proc confirms invoice mapping. Otherwise ship separately. Given €320 and manifest present, proceeding unless procurement objects.
Marta (Procurement): Confirmed invoice present and vendor agreed to €500 credit. OK to consolidate. I'll attach amendment to the RMA.
Ken (Infra): I set a contingency crossdock (DE->FR) ready; will kick if delay surpasses 30h. Monitoring on.
Diego (Logistics): Manifest uploaded to RMA-4319: https://files.redwood/rma/4319/manifest.zip. Labels printed.
Ava (SupplyOps): Proceeding with consolidation. Action items: Diego finalize MAWB pickup, Marta attach PO amendment, Ken standby for crossdock trigger. Closing loop in INC-2026-900. :white_check_mark:
